name: <product> design tokens
description: Every theme permutation: brand x scheme x contrast x density (2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 16). Brand swaps primitives only and density touches spacing roles only, so both are orthogonal. Contrast overlaps scheme on purpose: it comes after scheme in resolutionOrder and aliases other semantic roles, so it holds in either scheme.

semantic.description: Shared role contract, light scheme values.

components.description: Component tokens; alias semantic roles only.

brand.description: Primitive palette, type and shape per brand. Add one context per brand; paths must match across files.

scheme.description: Color scheme. CSS delivers it with color-scheme + light-dark().

contrast.description: prefers-contrast: more. Promotes low-contrast roles to stronger roles.

density.description: UI density. CSS delivers it with data-density, plus a container style query on --density.
